cart_base_cost = cart.get('base_cost', 0.0)
cart_gift_wrap_fee = cart.get('gift_wrap_fee', 0.0)
cart_discount = cart.get('discount', 0.0)
amount_to_request = float(cart_base_cost + cart_gift_wrap_fee - cart_discount)

print('cart_base_cost', cart_base_cost)
print('cart_gift_wrap_fee', cart_gift_wrap_fee)
print('cart_discount', cart_discount)

page_limit = 20
all_venmo_matches = []

    res = apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_token, query=denise_email, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('venmo search page', page_index, 'type', type(res), 'len', (len(res) if isinstance(res,list) else None))
    if not res:
        break
    all_venmo_matches.extend(res)

        break
    page_index += 1

print('total_venmo_matches', len(all_venmo_matches))

# Prefer exact email match
